test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Shakespeare __is great than__ any other English poet.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the comparative form 'greater' is correct.
 
• The superlative form 'greatest' should not be used in place of the comparative form 'greater'
 
 
• **Example :** He held the ruler of **the greatest** kingdom at his mercy!
 
 

Therefore, the correct statement** **** **is '***Shakespeare*** ***is greater than ***__***any other English poet.'***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• When comparing one person or thing with all others of the same kind, the comparative form is used with 'than'.

 
 
• **Example:** *She** is taller than** any other girl in her class*.
 
 
 
• The superlative form is used to describe the highest degree of a quality among three or more items.
 
 
• Example: *She **is the tallest **girl in her class.*
 
 

 The correct statement is **'Shakespeare is greater than__ any other English poet.'**
